risk_if_not_implemented: Without AI & Autonomous Technologies Ongoing Assessments, AI and autonomous systems may produce unreliable, biased or unsafe outputs, act outside authorized scope, or expose sensitive data. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Lack of oversight of internal controls (R-GV-6), Inability to Demonstrate Due Diligence / Due Care (R-GV-9), Unreliable Assurance / Decision Information (R-GV-10), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Conflict of Interest (COI) / Undue Influence / Insider Misconduct (MT-15), Workforce Shortage / Loss of Critical Skills / Labor Disruption (MT-25).

compensating_control_1.name: Data Subject Empowerment
compensating_control_1.justification: Data Subject Empowerment (PRI-39.1) provides privacy protection that compensates for the absence of AI & Autonomous Technologies Ongoing Assessments (AAT-33.2) by applying alternative privacy safeguards to protect personal data and honor data subject rights. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Contacts With Groups & Associations
compensating_control_2.description:
Mechanisms exist to establish contact with selected groups and associations within the security, compliance and resilience communities to: 
(1) Facilitate ongoing cybersecurity and data protection education and training for organizational personnel;
(2) Maintain currency with recommended cybersecurity and data protection practices, techniques and technologies; and
(3) Share current cybersecurity and/or data protection-related information including threats, vulnerabilities and incidents.
compensating_control_2.justification: Contacts With Groups & Associations (GOV-16) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of AI & Autonomous Technologies Ongoing Assessments (AAT-33.2) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
